reviews.title: Scene is great but not the app
reviews.text: It’s a great way to earn points quickly. Scene+ is great but the app needs a lot of work! I don’t find it user-friendly at all to check your points or to check the various rewards and benefits. For instance, it will say new rewards or new benefits, and when you click on it, it wants you to sign up or sign in, but you’re already signed in. It needs a real overhaul. If you just use it to collect points, it’s great, but not if you start exploring the app.

reviews.title: Horribly designed, now non-functional for the security-conscious
reviews.text: For years, this app has been temperamental and poorly designed. It’s an irritating and frustrating experience to attempt to use it, much like the Scene program itself. The latest design buries loadable offers making them harder to access. When it comes to security of the app and the service, I find it questionable. Randomly a few months ago my account was used by someone at a gas station in BC just after Scene switched to Shell. Of course this was fraud that someone easily perpetrated. Scene was responsive and fixed the problem after I jumped through a number of hoops. Now, the latest security issue is that app itself. Scotiabank has farmed out login security to the USA company Imperva which is owned by Texas-based Thales, which also has a significant presence in Israel. This supposed cybersecurity company now blocks login access on the app for security-conscious members who use a VPN this actually reducing security for users and making us more vulnerable to attack. Shame on Scotiabank for contracting a USA company especially one active in Israel. And shame on the bank for increasing our online risk by blocking VPN connections.
